name: Kodiak
seo_title: Kodiak Christmas Events for Kids 2026: 3 Events, 1 Free
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Kodiak, Alaska for 2026: 3 family events, 1 free, including a boat parade, with dates checked on each host's site.
lede: Kodiak lights its tree at the harbor, sends decorated boats down the Near Island Channel and stages a Nutcracker at the Gerald C. Wilson Auditorium.
celebrates: Kodiak's season is built around the harbor. The Kodiak Chamber of Commerce lists the city tree lighting at the Harbor Master building on November 28, with carolers, the Kodiak High School band, Next Step Dance, Santa, hot drinks and cookies. The Kodiak Maritime Museum's Harbor Lights Festival on December 19 sends fishing, sport and personal boats strung with lights through the Near Island Channel at 6 pm, after a holiday reception at KANA Marketplace. Next Step Dance Kodiak stages The Nutcracker from December 11 to 13.
lastyear: The Kodiak Maritime Museum's Harbor Lights Festival and Boat Parade ran on Saturday, December 20, 2025, according to the city events page, with illuminated boats and a parade through Near Island. The museum says it has sponsored the festival since 2013 and that the event features fishing, sport and personal vessels strung with lights. The parade route page lists the boat parade from 6 to 7 pm that Saturday. The 2026 festival moves to Saturday, December 19.
facts: Kodiak is an island city, and the Kodiak Maritime Museum has sponsored the Harbor Lights Festival since 2013. The parade of lit boats is watched from the shore along the Near Island Channel, and the museum has streamed it from the ferry dock on its Facebook page in a past year. The Gerald C. Wilson Auditorium, home of The Nutcracker, is listed at 722 Mill Bay Road by the Kodiak chamber, and another site gives a different street.
trains: Kodiak has no rail line, and we did not find a train ride on the island. The nearest Alaska Railroad site is the Seward Depot on the mainland. See our Seward and Anchorage pages for rail history and events there.
traditions: The city lights its tree at the Harbor Master building with carolers, a school band, Santa and hot drinks.
Fishing and personal boats strung with lights parade through the Near Island Channel.
Next Step Dance Kodiak's students perform the holiday ballet over one weekend.
kidfact: Kodiak's Harbor Lights boat parade has run since 2013, and its boats are fishing and personal vessels strung with lights.
faq: Kodiak lights its tree at the Harbor Master building, holds a Harbor Lights Festival with a lighted boat parade and stages a Nutcracker at the Gerald C. Wilson Auditorium.
Is there a free Christmas event in Kodiak?
The Harbor Lights boat parade is a public parade, so we list it as free. The tree lighting and Nutcracker do not print a price.
Where can kids meet Santa in Kodiak?
Santa visits the City of Kodiak Annual Christmas Tree Lighting on November 28, according to the program.
Is there a train ride in Kodiak?
No. Kodiak has no rail line, and we did not find a train ride on the island.
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Kodiak for 2026, and here is what he found: 3 family events, 1 of them free. The magic runs from November 28 (the City of Kodiak Annual Christmas Tree Lighting) through December 19 (the Harbor Lights Festival and Boat Parade), with The Nutcracker by Next Step Dance Kodiak (December 11 to 13) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.
